title: "Schematic Editor"
page-layout: full

  - editor.css
---

```{=html}
<div id="schematic-editor" class="fe-mount"></div>
<noscript><p>The Schematic Editor needs JavaScript.</p></noscript>
<script type="module">
  import { mount } from "./src/index.js";
  const tool = await mount(document.getElementById("schematic-editor"), {
    pack: "./symbol-pack/",
    open: new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("open"),
  });
  window.schematicEditorTool = tool;
  window.figureEditor = tool.app;
</script>
```
